meta.title: Contact
meta.description: Do you have a question or an idea, or is something not right on the map? Get in touch with NIPKaart.

title: Contact
intro: Do you have a question or an idea, or is something not right on the map? We are happy to help.

form.title: Send a message
form.name: Name
form.location_placeholder: Street and town, or the link to the parking space
form.privacy: We only use your details to answer your message and do not store them on the website.

email.title: Prefer e-mail?
email.text: You can also e-mail us directly. We reply in Dutch or English.

data.title: Municipality or data provider
data.text: Do you share open data about disabled parking spaces or garage occupancy? Choose ‘Municipality or data’ and tell us which dataset it is, and we will gladly see how we can show it.

code.title: A bug or technical idea?
code.text: NIPKaart is open source. You can also report it on GitHub.
